title: Minority lawmakers protest in Balochistan Assembly over missing girl
seoTitle: Quetta minority lawmakers protest missing girl

tea.why: Lawmakers protested authorities' failure to locate and recover a Hindu girl missing from Sibi for 27 days.
tea.want: Immediate steps to recover the missing girl and ensure her safe return.
tea.changed: Nov 15: Minority lawmakers called off their assembly floor protest after other members intervened and a senior minister assured action.

summary: Minority lawmakers staged a protest inside the Balochistan Assembly in Quetta regarding the authorities' failure to trace a missing Hindu girl from Sibi. According to reports, the girl was allegedly abducted, taken to Sindh, and subjected to forced conversion and marriage. During the assembly session, legislators Dr Ashok Kumar and Sanjay Kumar sat on the floor in front of the Speaker's dais and raised slogans to express their concern. Following interventions by other assembly members, the demonstration ended and the lawmakers returned to their seats. Senior Provincial Minister Zahoor Buledi assured the assembly that the Balochistan government would take the matter up with the Chief Minister.
demands: Immediate action for the recovery of the missing girl
Fair investigation into the abduction and conversion allegations
response: According to Indiablooms, Senior Provincial Minister Zahoor Buledi assured the assembly that the Balochistan government would take up the matter with the Chief Minister since it involved another province.

updates.text: Minority lawmakers sat on the assembly floor and raised slogans before ending their protest following intervention.
